thread:
Sara (Sales): Heads-up — Zenith is asking to reserve Dedicated capacity for a 6-month POC. They want regional split and a shared POC credit.
Dylan (SE): what sizes/regions are they proposing?
Sara (Sales): ask is: 10x A100 (us-west) + 2x A100 (eu-west) for 6 months. They want burst to 3x for short spikes and want to apply a $40k POC credit across both regions.
Omar (Finance): quick flag — a 25% discount on reserved rates? that's large for 6-month term. Do they want upfront or monthly billing?
Sara (Sales): customer prefers monthly billing to a single legal entity. Also asked to waive regional carveout fees.
Leah (SRE): technical note — triple burst is feasible but KV cache and model warmup will cause latency variance. We should put a spike window (e.g., 15 minutes) and a max sustained ratio in the SLO.
Daniel (DealDesk): putting this up for approval: (A) sign-off on 25% off reserved commit for 6 months, (B) allow POC credit to be applied across regions and deducted on invoice, (C) waive regional split fee.
Omar (Finance): approvable in principle but recommend: cap discount to 15% unless legal/CS exec approves higher; require a 10% non-refundable onboarding fee to cover cross-region placement; POC credit can be applied but must be invoiced to a single entity and reflected in billing as an internal allocation.
Sara (Sales): customer insists on 25%. Can we do a middle ground — 20% discount + $40k credit and onboarding fee waived if they pay first two months upfront?
Rafael (Ops): ops note — if we allow 3x burst, we should provision a fallback model variant to avoid request queuing when KV cache isn't warm. Also need autoscaler config adjusted.
Dylan (SE): agreed — recommend routing policy: primary -> reserved pool, fallback -> smaller quantized variant. Add cooldown to prevent oscillation.
cicd-bot: quota-check: available A100 equiv: us-west 200, eu-west 30. Allocation possible for requested commit if approved.
Leah (SRE): also call out export control check for EU deployment. Legal needs to confirm data residency language in SOW.
Daniel (DealDesk): I'll draft an approval email with these conditional terms: 20% discount approved if customer prepays months 1-2, onboarding fee waived; otherwise 15% + onboarding fee. POC credit accepted but must be tied to single invoice. Will route for signatures.
Omar (Finance): please cc billing@redwood and finance-legal@redwood on SOW. Approve conditional to signed SOW and payment terms.
Sara (Sales): I'll get customer legal contact and SOW skeleton. Rafael, can you queue provisioning after signatures?
Rafael (Ops): yep — will prepare a provisioning-runbook and tentative schedule once SOW countersigned. :thumbsup:
Sara (Sales): thanks everyone — syncing with Zenith now, will update thread with customer response.
